2472|2|10|700.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
2472|2|10|700.evidence: 16/30 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

2472|2|10|700.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
2472|2|10|700.evidence: USI median +0.401 over 30 corners (21 understeer, 2 mid-corner front reds)

2472|2|10|700.text: Trail-brake understeer: finish more braking before steering; caster +0.5 for camber-in-turn.
2472|2|10|700.evidence: 8/30 corners red on the fronts at turn-in

2472|2|10|700.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
2472|2|10|700.evidence: median peak rear slip 10.85; 1/1 launches spun

2472|2|10|700.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
2472|2|10|700.evidence: 8 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

2472|2|10|700.text: Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 4 stops (0 both-axle, 1 front-first, 0 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.52) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
